question.text: Section 9A of Income Tax Act provides:

answer.text: Safe harbour for offshore fund managers operating from India

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 9A: offshore fund manager operating from India doesn't create a Permanent Establishment (PE) if conditions met — unique 'safe harbour' regime. The Trap: Section 9A is specific to fund managers; not general tax. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B unique content.
